blocked when the operator
enabled that rule" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="210" x="780" y="460" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ed1" edge="1" parent="1" source="d1" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;" target="d2"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ed2" edge="1" parent="1" source="d2" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;" target="d3"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ed3" edge="1" parent="1" source="d3" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#b85450;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;" target="d4"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="clean" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=center;fontStyle=1;" value="All four pass
→ ReviewOutcome::Clean" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="180" x="1040" y="460" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="ed4" edge="1" parent="1" source="d4" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;" target="clean"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="blocked" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=11;align=center;fontStyle=1;" value="Any match
→ ReviewOutcome::Blocked(reason)
stored as a durable verdict" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="260" x="60" y="580" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="unver" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=10;align=center;fontStyle=1;" value="Collector failed, provider failed, reply unreadable or
truncated, or the review row could not be stored
→ ReviewOutcome::Unverifiable(reason)
NOTHING is stored, so a later request retries" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="70" width="360" x="360" y="580" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="eu1" edge="1" parent="1" source="s2" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#d79b00;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;dashed=1;" target="unver"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="eu1_l" connectable="0" parent="eu1" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=10;fontColor=#d79b00;" value="could not run" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" x="0.2" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="eu2" edge="1" parent="1" source="s4" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;html=1;strokeColor=#d79b00;strokeWidth=2;endArrow=block;endFill=1;dashed=1;" target="unver"> <mxGeometry relative="1" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="eu2_l" connectable="0" parent="eu2" style="edgeLabel;html=1;align=center;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=10;fontColor=#d79b00;" value="failed or unreadable" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry relative="1" x="0.2" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="store" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;strokeWidth=2;verticalAlign=top;align=left;spacingLeft=10;spacingTop=6;" value="" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="200" width="1160" x="60" y="700" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="store_t" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#375623;" value="6. STORE — the reviews table (every outcome that reached a decision)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="700" x="72" y="708" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="store_c" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=top;fontFamily=Courier New;fontSize=10;fontColor=#1a1a1a;spacingLeft=2;" value="Recorded per review: artifact identity, policy fingerprint, verdict, blocked flag, summary, findings, coverage,
reviewable bytes total and sent, opaque executables, reviewed paths, model, prompt version, collector version, timestamp.

Why this matters: the model's own text never reaches a refusal detail or a reason phrase, because a hostile model could
quote a key or plant a fake code there. The refusal detail states the verdict in our words; the model's summary lives
in this row and in the log instead. /why/<id> and /api/reviews read this table to explain what was reviewed and why.

The prompt and collector versions are part of the policy fingerprint, so bumping either re-reviews every artifact in
every ecosystem once, on first request after the upgrade." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="1130" x="72" y="736" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="legend" parent="1" style="text;html=1;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;fontSize=12;fontStyle=1;fontColor=#666666;" value="Legend" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="200" x="60" y="940" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lg1" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f8cecc;strokeColor=#b85450;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="blocking decision" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="160" x="60" y="970" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lg2" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="clean" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="130" x="235" y="970" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lg3" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="unverifiable (nothing stored)" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="200" x="380" y="970" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="lg4" parent="1" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=10;align=center;" value="pipeline stage" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="160" x="595" y="970" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div: 6. STORE — the reviews table (every outcome that reached a decision)

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding-top: 723px; margin-left: 36px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #1a1a1a;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: light-dark(#1a1a1a, #d7d7d7); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: nowrap;

div.div:
Recorded per review: artifact identity, policy fingerprint, verdict, blocked flag, summary, findings, coverage,
reviewable bytes total and sent, opaque executables, reviewed paths, model, prompt version, collector version, timestamp.
Why this matters: the model's own text never reaches a refusal detail or a reason phrase, because a hostile model could
quote a key or plant a fake code there. The refusal detail states the verdict in our words; the model's summary lives
in this row and in the log instead. /why/ and /api/reviews read this table to explain what was reviewed and why.
The prompt and collector versions are part of the policy fingerprint, so bumping either re-reviews every artifact in
every ecosystem once, on first request after the upgrade.
